_schema: curve: xpToNext(level) = k * level^2 (xp needed to advance FROM that level). characters: base = level-1 stats, growth = per-level gains (fractions accumulate and floor). active:false members exist in data from day one (party-of-N canon) and join via story flags.

curve._why: 2026-07-31 user ruling: leveling should be quicker in the first ~5 levels with starter enemies. k 25->10: to L5 costs 300xp total (~15 forest / ~25 meadow fights) instead of 750. Late-game pacing re-tunes when later regions land.

lake.name: Lake
lake.desc: The last lamplighter of Emberbrook. Steadier than Vesper, slower to swing, harder to knock down.
lake._why: ADDED 2026-08-02 (end-to-end wiring, plan §4/0b). He is player two in Chapter One's script and the second half of the pact, and he had NO party record at all — the audit's G6. He joins on 'lake-joined', which Chapter One's pact beat sets — the moment the two keepers swear the oath — and never leaves. He is NOT active at new game: Act I is Vesper walking in alone, and starting him active would silently halve the xp share of the chapter before he exists. Whether he is a BATTLING party member at all or a narrative companion is an OPEN USER QUESTION (docs/plans/end-to-end-wiring.md R8); if the answer is companion, this record loses its joinFlag and nothing else changes. Stats are Vesper's silhouette rotated, not a copy: -1 atk, +1 def, +1 spd at base, and def grows fastest of the three — the one who stands in front.

maren.name: Maren
maren.desc: Rapids-runner of Dellhollow, Odessa's daughter. Fast on her feet, faster in an argument.
